judgment.rationale: This is a real 0.101/dev-build Peek regression, but it is already assigned and linked to PR #49963.

judgment.recommended_action: Track upstream PR #49963; no separate dashboard design/action.

issue_context.summary: Peek shows a flashing spinner while navigating media previews in a 0.101 development build, creating visual noise even for quick loads.
known_information: Reporter supplied numbered reproduction steps and a video attachment.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
PR #49963 is linked as closing #50019 and remains open.
PR #49963 includes Peek file previewer changes and unit tests for previewer reuse.
inferences: The report appears to be a genuine 0.101 Peek regression, but active upstream maintainer work already covers it.
The linked PR intends to reduce flicker by reusing previewers instead of rebuilding UI on each navigation.
issue_context.analysis: The latest upstream evidence points to ownership and a concrete PR. Dashboard should not expose request-info or duplicate design actions.
initial_investigation: PR #49963 diff introduces IReusablePreviewer and DoubleBufferedImageControl and refactors FilePreview/PreviewerFactory behavior.
The PR title is "[Peek] Enable reusable previewers for Peek to fix flicker" and it also closes #50016.
